name: TechPark CV Praia campus data centre (NOSi-managed)
developer: TechPark CV (Parque Tecnológico Arquipélago Digital de Cabo Verde) / NOSi EPE (operator); AfDB-financed
notes: Sotavento / Santiago / Praia (~15 ha campus). Park defined by AfDB as construction+equipment of a data center, business center, incubation and training centres; Data Center within Praia campus managed by NOSi; DC building completed ~end-2022; campuses inaugurated 2025-05-05 (Praia). AfDB financing ~€45.5M of ~€51.85M park (≈US$57M across both phases per fintechnews.africa). DCD (2023-08-01): €14M phase-2 loan signed for two additional data centers + DR site (renewable-powered), Praia campus located <2 km from legacy NOSi DC. Capacity not public: capacity_mw null. Island sweep: no public DC evidence found for other Sotavento islands/concelhos (Santiago outside Praia, Maio, Fogo, Brava) or for Santa Luzia.

name: NOSi data centre, Praia (legacy AfDB-backed)
developer: NOSi EPE (Núcleo Operacional da Sociedade de Informação, government ICT agency)
notes: Sotavento / Santiago / Praia. Legacy AfDB-supported government DC located <2 km from TechPark (DCD 2023-08-01; AfDB Adesina visit story via etradeforall: 'I am delighted that we are financing it [the NOSi data center] and the adjoining Cabo Verde Technology Park'). SVOM hosts its CPV2 satellite station 'on the site of the NOSi (DATA CENTER) in Praia' (start-up 2020-08-31, ~14.92N/-23.51W). NOSi lists address Edifício Business Center, Parque Tecnológico, Praia - identity vs TechPark DC unresolved at address level; kept as separate record per methodology (do not merge without parcel/address proof). DatacenterMap NOSI profile = C-grade directory seed. Capacity null.

name: Cabo Verde Telecom (CVTelecom) data centre, Praia
notes: Sotavento / Santiago / Praia. Carrier-neutral colocation/data-centre service claim carried by directories (PeeringDB facility 13574 'Cabo Verde Telecom'; datacenters.com Cape Verde provider listings) and trade/sponsor material per methodology. NOT confirmed by a CVTelecom-controlled page, ARME licence, BOE notice, or municipal record in this pass; exact building address and capacity unverified. Grade C (directory-level) / B/C overall per CV methodology; upgrade only with operator/regulator primary evidence. Capacity null.

name: Praia Data Center (MITT, 2010-2014)
developer: Client: MITT (Ministry of Infrastructure, Telecommunications and Transport); construction supervision: NRV / Grupo Norvia
notes: Sotavento / Santiago / Praia. Historical/institutional record: NRV/Grupo Norvia supervised 2010-2014 a 'Technological Center for processing and data storage, software development, website hosting, etc (Tier III)' for MITT, Praia, Ilha de Santiago. Likely the early government National Data Center (a directory claim credits Huawei delivery in the 2010-2014 e-gov phase - caboverdeexpert.com, C-grade). Current building/operator (NOSi vs ministry vs central-bank server room) unverified; kept as dated lead (C+ seed) per no-deletion rule. Capacity null.

name: Unitel T+ data centre
developer: Unitel T+ (Unitel International Holdings group; second mobile/ISP licensee, commercial launch ~2021)
notes: Sotavento / Santiago / Praia (island to verify). Contractor portfolio (CVNET) lists a 'Data Center UNITEL T+' project - rack layout/installation, UPS backup power, cooling systems. Lead only: no ARME licence, operator filing, or municipal record confirming a dedicated facility found in this pass. Grade C. Capacity null.

name: TechPark CV Mindelo campus data centre + phase-2 DR site
notes: Barlavento / São Vicente / Mindelo. Second TechPark campus inaugurated 2025-05-06; AfDB release states the Mindelo facility includes a data centre, incubation hub and training centre. Phase 2 (€14M/≈US$15.3M, signed 2023-08-01) adds two data centers and a disaster-recovery site on the São Vicente campus, renewable-energy powered; AfDB TOR (2026-04-28) confirms Phase II in implementation (status construction/under development for the phase-2 DC/DR scope). Bantumen notes Cabo Verde now has three data centers and five digital-economy buildings across both campuses. Capacity null. Other Barlavento islands (Santo Antão, São Nicolau, Sal, Boa Vista) and uninhabited Santa Luzia: no public DC projects found in this sweep.

name: Praia cable landing stations (EllaLink branch, WACS, SHARE, CVT domestic, Atlantis-2)
developer: Cabo Verde Telecom (EllaLink branch + domestic inter-island cable); WACS/SHARE consortia; Atlantis-2 consortium
notes: Sotavento / Santiago / Praia. CONNECTIVITY INFRASTRUCTURE - NOT a data centre (no server/hosting/colo evidence promoted per methodology). EIB agreed US$25M (2019) for CVTelecom's EllaLink connection as part of a US$60M CVT programme (4G, FTTH, solar); DCD 2022-09-13 (cited in methodology, checked 2026-08-12) lists EllaLink branch, WACS, SHARE and CVT domestic cable at Praia; legacy Atlantis-2 (RFS 2000) reported disconnected Jan 2022. Landing stations may host PoP equipment only.

name: Commercial colocation / hyperscaler cloud region (verified negative)
notes: No AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI Cabo Verde cloud region or local zone - absence documented as a checked fact in the CV methodology (2026-08-12) and no hyperscaler region evidence surfaced in this run's searches; reseller/VPS pages are service evidence only.
